children: U.S. firearm maker's fiscal Q1 net sales rose 32% yr/yr
EPS for fiscal Q1 was $0.06, compared with $0.08 a year earlier
Gross margin improved to 28.7%, aided by $2.9 mln non-recurring tariff refund
Smith & Wesson expects Q2 sales to be roughly 10% above last year
Company sees fiscal 2027 revenue growing 5-7% over fiscal 2026
Company anticipates strong demand and normal seasonal environment for the remainder of the year
DEMAND IN CONSUMER AND PROFESSIONAL CHANNELS - Co said solid demand in both consumer and professional channels contributed to sales growth
TARIFF REFUND - Gross margin was aided by a $2.9 mln non-recurring tariff refund
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aerospace & defense peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Smith & Wesson Brands Inc is $17.25, about 35% above its September 2 closing price of $12.78
